subject: planner: merge FullSchema and FullNames of subplans when rewriting "in (subquery)" to inner join (#54334)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent: only planner change is in `pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go` `handleInSubquery()` when rewriting `IN (subquery)` to inner join+distinct-agg. It propagates `FullSchema/FullNames` from an outer `LogicalJoin` into the newly built join so redundant NATURAL/USING-join columns (e.g. `t1.c0`) remain resolvable after the rewrite, without exposing inner-subquery columns. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, visibility, or session/txn behavior for this change; later upstream history doesn’t indicate this specific change was reverted or fixed.
